entities.name: Miguel Ángel Contreras Llajaruna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Ángel Contreras Llajaruna is a Peruvian Roman Catholic prelate who is an Auxiliary Bishop-Elect of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Callao. He was the first bishop to be appointed by Pope Leo XIV. Prior to this, he was the episcopal vicar for Consecrated Life of the diocese of Callao and superior of the América del Sur district of the Marist Fathers.
